page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number 116 at left and "GEOGRAPH. LIB. III" at right. Main text in one column of verse and headings. Marginal notes in the left margin, beside the verse lines (Zeugma, Idume, Balsamum in Iudaea, Fibull.lib.1, Stat.Syl.lib.1, Lucr. lib.6, Purpura Tyria & Sidonia optimae, Ouid.Trist. lib.4, Idem de Ponto lib.1, Cadmus fuit Sidonius, Ausonius de claris urbibus). Below the text, the catchword Orontes at the right.

l.i: Pacis iter: qua dulce nemus florentis Idumes,
Qua pretiosa Tyros rubeat, qua purpura succo
Sidonys iterata vadis, vbi germine primum
Candida felices sudent opo balsama virga.
Vt q; maris vastum prospectet turribus aequor
Prima ratem ventis credere docta Tyros.

p.i: Quasq; Tyrus niveas fecat, & Sidonia rupes.

l.i: Diffindens terram magnum concinnat hiatum:
In Tyria Sidone quod accidit.
Hic, qui Sidonio fulget sublimis in ostro
Dux fuerat belli, proximus ille duci.
Liquit Agenorides Sidonia moenia Cadmus,
Poneret vt muros in meliore loco.
Vellet Alexandri si quarta colonia poni.
Ambarum locus vnus: & has furor ambitionis
In certamen agit. Vitiorum turbida vulgo
Vtraque & amentis populi male sana tumultu,
Hac Nilo munita quod est penitusque repositis
Infinuata locis fecunda, situque superbit.
Illa quod infidis opponitur aemula Persis.
Et vos ite pares: Macedumque attollite nomen,
Magnus Alexander te condidit: ille Seleucum
Nuncupat. Ingenuum cuius fuit anchora signum,
Qualis inusta solet, generis nota certa per omnem
Nam sobolis seriem natima cucurrit imago.

page.notes: Marginal notes are partly illegible in the scan; the notes above are best readings. Right-hand edge of page is in shadow. Catchword "Orontes" at right foot. The head "Sidon oppidum Phoeniciae." and "Antiochia ciuitas Coelosyriae." are set in roman type and treated as level 2 headings.
